instruction: Add an outgoing SMTP server in Thunderbird with hostname smtp.gmail.com, port 587, and STARTTLS connection security.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent attempted to configure Thunderbird for sending emails without incoming service. It navigated Account Settings, added SMTP server (smtp-mail.outlook.com, port 587, STARTTLS), and set up account via manual/advanced configuration. Failed because the task was infeasible and model should have recognized that.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate Thunderbird Account Settings, add/edit SMTP servers with specific hostname/port/security settings, interact with Account Setup wizard, use manual and advanced configuration, fill form fields, handle dialog boxes
metadata.failure_analysis: Original task was marked 'infeasible' - model should have reported inability but instead tried to configure the account. Model spent 50 turns actively setting up SMTP and account settings.
metadata.task_rationale: Decomposed the SMTP configuration part that the model successfully demonstrated. Task focuses on adding an SMTP server with specific settings, which the model showed clear ability to do.
metadata.explanation: Task requires adding an outgoing SMTP server in Thunderbird with Gmail settings. Evaluator kills Thunderbird to flush prefs.js, then reads SMTP server configuration from prefs.js and checks hostname=smtp.gmail.com, port=587, try_ssl=2 (STARTTLS).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly parses Thunderbird prefs.js using regex to extract all user_pref entries and filters SMTP server settings from mail.smtpserver.* keys
Metric correctly handles expected parameter for type='rule' - directly accesses expected.get('hostname'), expected.get('port'), expected.get('try_ssl') without wrapping
Expected values are semantically correct: hostname='smtp.gmail.com', port=587 (standard STARTTLS port), try_ssl=2 (Thunderbird's internal value for STARTTLS)
Complete coverage: all three instruction requirements (hostname, port, STARTTLS security) are verified with appropriate partial credit weighting
Postconfig correctly kills Thunderbird and waits 3s to ensure prefs.js is flushed to disk before reading
Metric iterates all SMTP servers and returns best match score, correctly handling the case where multiple servers may exist
